nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Prisma ORM schema defining all 32 database models (User, Trip, Location, Photo, Activity, Transportation, Lodging, EntityLink, VisaRequirement, PdfImport, etc.) with PostGIS-backed geospatial fields, relations, and Postgres column mappings for the Travel Life application.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses @map/@@map directives to translate camelCase Prisma fields to snake_case Postgres columns, and self-relations (e.g., User.travelPartner) for bidirectional associations.

nodes.name: clear-weather-cache.sql
nodes.summary: One-off maintenance SQL script that deletes all cached weather_data rows to force fresh fetches after switching from precipitation probability to precipitation amount.

nodes.name: generate-airports.js
nodes.summary: Node.js build script that downloads OurAirports CSV datasets, parses and cross-references airport/country records, filters to airports with IATA codes and scheduled service, and writes a deduplicated airports.json data file.

nodes.name: 001_standardize_timezones.sql
nodes.summary: Idempotent manual SQL migration that creates a _manual_migrations tracking table and normalizes non-standard timezone abbreviations (e.g., EST, GMT, JST) across the users table and related tables to IANA timezone names.

nodes.name: migrate-and-start.sh
nodes.summary: Container entrypoint shell script that waits for Postgres readiness, ensures the Prisma client and PostGIS extension exist, runs Prisma migrations plus manual SQL migrations, prepares upload directories with correct permissions, and finally execs the application (dropping root privileges when possible).

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file aggregating Jest test fixtures (users, trips, photos) — sample records, factory functions, and valid/invalid input payloads used across backend service and controller tests.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting backend test helper utilities for JWT token generation, mock Express request/response/next objects, mock file uploads, and response assertion helpers.

nodes.name: setup.ts
nodes.summary: Jest global setup file that configures test environment variables (NODE_ENV, JWT secrets), silences noisy console output, and raises the default test timeout.

nodes.name: dietaryTags.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the fixed list of dietary preference tags (vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher, gluten-free, etc.) with emoji, used for user dietary preference selection across the app.

nodes.name: visaRequirement.service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the visa requirement service covering lookups between passport/destination country pairs, domestic-travel handling, multi-destination checks, visa-action determination, country extraction from addresses, and graceful handling of missing data.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Complete REST API reference for the backend, documenting authentication, the request/response envelope format, and every endpoint group (trips, locations, photos, activities, transportation, lodging, journal, entity links, tags, companions, checklists, search, collaboration, Immich, weather, backup, AI/PDF import, flight tracking, travel documents, and more).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level documentation index providing quick links and navigation into architecture, API, guides, plans, and user-guide docs, along with a project overview and role-based reading paths.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: End-user guide covering account setup, trip management, locations, photos/albums, transportation, lodging, activities, journals, timeline view, entity linking, tags/companions, PDF import, search, settings, and keyboard shortcuts.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: Flat ESLint configuration for the frontend enabling recommended JS/TypeScript rules plus React Hooks and React Refresh plugin rules for all .ts/.tsx files, excluding the dist build output.

nodes.name: nginx.conf
nodes.summary: Nginx server configuration for the standard Docker deployment, serving the SPA build, proxying /api and /uploads to the backend container, applying gzip compression and security headers, and exposing a /health endpoint. Expects TLS termination by an upstream reverse proxy.

nodes.name: nginx.truenas.conf
nodes.summary: TrueNAS-oriented Nginx configuration variant that proxies /api and /uploads to a backend host/port supplied via BACKEND_HOST/BACKEND_PORT environment variables, adds longer proxy timeouts and upload caching, and serves the SPA build.

nodes.name: postcss.config.js
nodes.summary: Minimal PostCSS configuration enabling the Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer plugins for the frontend build pipeline.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Web App Manifest declaring the Travel Life PWA's name, icons, theme colors, display mode, categories, and app shortcuts, enabling installability and standalone-app behavior.

nodes.name: offline.html
nodes.summary: Static fallback page served by the service worker when the app is offline and no cached route matches, informing the user of offline status.

nodes.name: App.css
nodes.summary: Near-empty top-level stylesheet for the App component; styling is otherwise handled by Tailwind utility classes.

nodes.name: ChipSelector.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable multi-select chip UI component with a search filter, select-all/clear-all actions, and customizable id/label accessors, used to pick items (tags, companions, etc.) from a list.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the daily-view component family (DailyView, DayNavigator, ActivityCard, TransportationCard, LodgingCard, JournalCard, embedded location/album cards, and empty-day placeholder).

nodes.name: InlineEdit.tsx
nodes.summary: Click-to-edit inline editing components: InlineEdit for text/textarea values and InlineEditNumber for numeric values, both with validation, save/cancel keyboard shortcuts, loading state, and toast feedback on save.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the PWA-related UI components and their prop types — offline indicator, sync status, data freshness indicator, install prompts, storage management/warnings, and conflict-resolution modals.

nodes.name: SourcePdfBadge.tsx
nodes.summary: Small badge component that displays the originating PDF filename for entities created via AI PDF import, with a click handler to open/download the source file while stopping event propagation.

nodes.name: parseCsv
nodes.summary: Parses raw CSV text into an array of row objects, handling quoted fields and embedded commas/newlines without an external CSV library.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the airport data build: fetches airports and countries CSVs, maps ICAO/IATA codes to names and coordinates, filters to airports with IATA codes and scheduled service, deduplicates by ICAO/IATA, sorts alphabetically, and writes the resulting airports.json file.

nodes.name: ChipSelector
nodes.summary: React component rendering a searchable list of selectable chips with select-all/clear-all controls and a summary count of selected items.

nodes.name: InlineEdit
nodes.summary: React component providing click-to-edit text/textarea editing with validation, keyboard shortcuts (Enter/Escape), loading state during save, and toast notifications on success/error.

nodes.name: InlineEditNumber
nodes.summary: React component variant of InlineEdit for numeric values, supporting min/max/step constraints, prefix/suffix display, and the same click-to-edit save/cancel interaction pattern.

nodes.name: SourcePdfBadge
nodes.summary: React component rendering a small badge showing a truncated source PDF filename with a click handler that stops propagation and opens the stored file.
